changes.summary: Post-hardening review: logged <240-byte MockPool bypass nuance in initialize_config and execute_checks.
changes.details: In initialize_config (lib.rs:98) and execute_checks (lib.rs:251, 284, 322), DBC owner, discriminator, creator==authority, and base_vault checks are guarded by `if data.len() >= BASE_RESERVE_OFFSET + 8` (240 bytes) to keep 16-byte MockPool tests working. Because init_mock_pool is still compiled into the binary and 0-byte or 16-byte pool accounts skip the `creator == authority` check in initialize_config, a non-atomic launch could still be front-run by passing a <240-byte account as `pool` to brick the mint's config PDA. Mitigations before mainnet: (1) always bundle createPoolWithTransferHook + initialize_config + initialize_extra_account_meta_list atomically in a single tx/bundle; (2) optionally gate init_mock_pool and `< 240`-byte branches behind `#[cfg(feature = "local-test")]` so the mainnet build unconditionally requires `data.len() >= BASE_RESERVE_OFFSET + 8`.
changes.next: Decide whether to feature-gate MockPool (<240B) before mainnet build; write atomic mainnet launch script in scripts/.
